readinessDefinitions.owner-decision-recorded: All source-evidence proofs and a narrowly scoped owner source-ledger decision are recorded; it remains non-production.
readinessDefinitions.immutable-archive-then-owner-decision: The source has no named owner source-ledger decision: a local row still awaits immutable archive, or a newly archived row now awaits the same named decision.
readinessDefinitions.owner-scope-decision-after-archive: The local evidence contract is complete except immutable archive, and the later decision must also resolve the stated operational or geometry scope.
readinessDefinitions.owner-scope-decision-recorded-awaiting-a: The owner has resolved operational or geometry scope and approved downstream use, but production proof and eligibility remain blocked until every named immutable readback is integrated.
readinessDefinitions.owner-scope-decision-ready: Immutable archive evidence is recorded, but a separately named owner decision must still resolve the stated operational or geometry scope.
readinessDefinitions.external-evidence-blocked: The named production source lacks required source evidence or has an external authority, rights, completeness, or engagement block; an owner decision cannot cure it.
